parent_objective: design no-PPO directional repair after M1290 classifies M1288 as magnitude compression
blocked_by: M1290 shows exact-loss improvement with after_mutually_exclusive_fraction=1.0

public_gates: M1291 must preserve actor input contract
M1291 must not use private holdout
M1291 must design a directional repair path that directly addresses mutually-exclusive sign rows
M1291 must specify whether implementation should use actor_mean continuation, pair-group objective, trainable-scope escalation, or corpus repair
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat scalar loss improvement as row-wise directional repair

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the next no-PPO repair path after M1290 magnitude-compression diagnosis
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: repair design only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, PPO, paper-level, closed-loop, high-fidelity, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design ignores M1290 mutually-exclusive sign rows
stop if design requires actor-input expansion
stop if design starts PPO before directional relation is positive
fallback_plan: if actor_mean continuation is plausible, admit a crossing-aware bounded probe
if actor_mean is capacity-limited, admit trainable-scope escalation design
if row labels conflict, route to corpus relabel/refresh audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: fifth milestone in objective-only update branch

allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next manifest if design admits implementation

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1291 designs a fixed-current source-history directional repair and does not evaluate closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future implementation must make correct-history and wrong-history preferences both positive row-wise
future implementation must still avoid actor-input shortcut labels
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1290 directional conflict rows from M1288 before/after exact objective rows.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no bounded repair path can target both-directional rows, record negative evidence and keep PPO blocked.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: A no-PPO directional repair path can be designed to address the M1290 magnitude-compression failure mode without actor-input expansion.
success_criteria: design directly references M1290 mutually-exclusive sign rows
design selects a bounded next implementation or routes to corpus repair
design specifies row-wise directional pass/fail gates
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1291 passes if it designs a bounded no-PPO directional repair path or explicitly routes to corpus repair without overclaiming.
